name: thryx
description: Skills for ThryX project management over MCP: issues, projects, cycles, the client-facing Roadmap (releases, promises, outcomes, and its public link), and documents in the ThryX workspaces you connect, plus a product-management skill for writing tickets, PRDs, ADRs, and project docs and running follow-ups.

interface.shortDescription: Read and update issues, projects, cycles, and documents in ThryX
interface.longDescription: Skills for the ThryX workspaces you connect over MCP (one server per workspace) so an agent can search and triage issues, plan cycles, keep the client-facing Roadmap current, and read or write project documents. Calls that are hard to undo are refused until the caller passes an explicit confirmation flag on that same request — a deliberate speed bump against careless automation, not a permission boundary.
defaultPrompt: What is the status of my current cycle?
Triage the untriaged issues in this project
Draft a Roadmap of promises and outcomes from these tickets
